items.summary_original: On 21 July, the Fusion Industry Association published a paper outlining a practical EU financing roadmap for commercial fusion energy. As fusion projects move from research to demonstration, first-of-a-kind plants and commercial deployment, they require different funding and financing tools at each stage of development. Europe's financing framework must evolve from a collection of individual programmes into a coherent funding architecture that supports the entire fusion commercialisation journey.
